description.en: Plays a system sound when an agent finishes a task, waits for your input, has a plan sent back for changes, or is stopped manually. Pick all four sounds in Settings → Notification sounds; “None” turns a moment off.
description.zh-cn: 任务结束、等待你输入、计划被退回修改、手动终止任务时播放系统提示音。四个声音可在 设置 → 提示音 里选择，「无」表示不播放。
